description:
Extended Range for Every Ride: Our e-bike offers an impressive range of around 40-50km in fully electric mode and around 70-80km in pedal-assist mode. You can confidently explore more places and enjoy longer rides without worrying about running out of battery.

Versatile Shimano 21-Speed Gears: With the reliable Shimano 21-speed gears, you can adjust your pedaling intensity to match any terrain or riding style. Enjoy effortless gear shifts and a comfortable riding experience.

Advanced Pedal Assist Technology: Equipped with cadence and upgraded torque sensors, the pedal-assist feature intelligently amplifies your pedaling efforts, offering a natural and responsive riding experience.

Robust and Durable Build:Crafted from a 6061 aluminum alloy frame, our e-bike is both lightweight and sturdy, ensuring a comfortable ride while withstanding various riding conditions.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes with Power Cut-Off:The hydraulic disc brakes provide reliable and precise stopping power, enhancing safety on your rides. The power cut-off feature instantly disables the motor when you brake, ensuring additional control and safety.

Enhanced Control with Twist Throttle: The convenient twist throttle on the right side of the handlebar gives you immediate access to power without pedaling. It offers a quick boost when needed or allows for relaxed cruising.

Customizable and Convenient Display: The LCD display provides essential information about speed, distance, battery level, and more. Stay informed and in control of your ride. Additionally, the LED headlight powered by the battery ensures visibility during nighttime adventures.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns
